FN-2JVWBIS-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 128
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 128 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development would establish the Alabama Sickle Cell Oversight and Regulatory Commission
as a division within the Alabama Department of Public Health beginning October 1, 2026. This
could increase the administrative obligations of the Department by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the cost to provide the administrative services necessary for the Commission to
carry out its duties. However, any costs incurred would be offset by funds appropriated for use
by the Commission on behalf of the Commission. For FY 2025, total estimated funds available
to the board were $1.98 million and estimated expenditures were $1.90 million.
The provisions of this bill would provide for the continuance of the Alabama Sickle Cell
Oversight and Regulatory Commission until October 1, 2030, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset
Law.
